name: workspace
description: Dynamic Portfolio Hub - React + Tailwind Frontend with Python Backend

scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:frontend & pnpm run dev:backend
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.start: pnpm run build && pnpm run start:backend
